authority: Current 2.0 player-journey map. Copy text remains owner-authored in the prose exchange workbook or CSV.

roundTripPolicy.board: Penpot owns flow, adjacency, surfaces, and UX notes. It does not own final prose.
roundTripPolicy.prose: Excel or CSV owns owner status, owner draft, and owner note, keyed by stable copyId.
roundTripPolicy.import: Import produces a reviewed change plan only. ESP changes require direct interactive houseCARL work; source and data changes remain separately approved.
